There are so many gems, and experimental themes emerge as you look through his larger corpus. The visuals make me want to return to Tokyo immediately. #bladerunner

bullets.title: The Neverending Story
bullets.note: This was both my favorite movie and favorite book for years as a kid. When I got in trouble in elementary school and was sent to detention, I would pretend like I hated the library, as it was one of the detention locations in our tiny school. As “punishment,” I would then get sent to the books and go straight to the shelf where I’d last stashed [_The Neverending Story_](https://el2.fourhourmail.com/c/n4u05gdnnavh2go89hq/p8heh9h7vmk337iq/aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuYW1hem9uLmNvbS9OZXZlcmVuZGluZy1TdG9yeS1NaWNoYWVsLUVuZGUvZHAvMDE0MDM4NjMzNS8=). I’d put it in the wrong section so that only I could find it! Watching the movie again as an adult, I was struck by a few things: (1) It ages really well. There are only a few old-school blue-screen portions that look antiquated, but the incredible animatronics and soundtrack still have magic. (2) There are some deeply philosophical themes and undertones that I didn’t get as a child but found helpful this time around. And (3) [Falkor](https://el2.fourhourmail.com/c/n4u05gdnnavh2go89hq/x0hph6h7go8rrnf5/aHR0cHM6Ly9lbi53aWtpcGVkaWEub3JnL3dpa2kvTGlzdF9vZl9UaGVfTmV2ZXJlbmRpbmdfU3RvcnlfY2hhcmFjdGVycyNGYWxrb3I=) is still the best. If you’re not going to watch this movie but want a good teaser (spoiler alert!), [here is a short clip with the sinister Gmork](https://el2.fourhourmail.com/c/n4u05gdnnavh2go89hq/kkhmh6h97rgddnfl/aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cueW91dHViZS5jb20vd2F0Y2g_dj01c0VabU1lSDk2UQ==). For those who’ve already seen the movie, I highly suggest reading the book, which—like the [_His Dark Materials_](https://el2.fourhourmail.com/c/n4u05gdnnavh2go89hq/58hvh7h9eqpvvkt6/aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuYW1hem9uLmNvbS9EYXJrLU1hdGVyaWFscy1ZZWFybGluZy0zLWJvb2stQm94ZWQvZHAvMDQ0MDQxOTUxNC8=) trilogy by Philip Pullman—has layers upon layers that are nearly impossible to translate to the screen.

bullets.title: YETI Rambler® 20 oz. Tumbler
bullets.note: I bought this in Austin at [YETI’s flagship store](https://el2.fourhourmail.com/c/n4u05gdnnavh2go89hq/qvh8h7h6xzg77qhl/aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cueWV0aS5jb20vZW5fVVMvZmxhZ3NoaXAuaHRtbA==), and it travels with me everywhere. For the last few months, I’ve used it every morning to keep my tea hot (typically [chaga](https://el2.fourhourmail.com/c/n4u05gdnnavh2go89hq/g3hnh5hzvr7ddgsr/aHR0cHM6Ly91cy5mb3Vyc2lnbWF0aWMuY29tL3Byb2R1Y3RzL2luc3RhbnQtY2hhZ2E=) or [pu-erh tea](https://el2.fourhourmail.com/c/n4u05gdnnavh2go89hq/9qhzhnh270kqq0i9/aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cucGlxdWV0ZWEuY29tL2NvbGxlY3Rpb25zL2FsbC9wcm9kdWN0cy9wdWVyLWJsYWNr), plus [unsweetened Laird Superfood Creamer](https://el2.fourhourmail.com/c/n4u05gdnnavh2go89hq/3ohphkhdw06oombr/aHR0cHM6Ly9sYWlyZHN1cGVyZm9vZC5jb20vcHJvZHVjdHMvbGFpcmQtc3VwZXJmb29kLXVuc3dlZXRlbmVkLW9yaWdpbmFsLWNyZWFtZXItbmV3)) and every afternoon to keep my iced tea cool. I don’t have to worry about condensation or water puddles on my table, and in my experience, it keeps things hot or cold for HOURS. The MagSlider™ magnetic closing mechanism is a much bigger deal than you’ll realize initially, especially for cleaning. [They are available with custom designs](https://el2.fourhourmail.com/c/n4u05gdnnavh2go89hq/n2hohvhodmw880t6/aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cueWV0aS5jb20vZW5fVVMvY3VzdG9tLXNob3AtZHJpbmt3YXJlLmh0bWw=), and mine features [a Texas rattlesnake](https://el2.fourhourmail.com/c/n4u05gdnnavh2go89hq/48hvheh2ovz55ecx/aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cueWV0aS5jb20vZW5fVVMvc3RhdGUtcHJpZGUuaHRtbA==). Here’s the official description: “Any tumbler that’s coming along for the ride needs to be tough enough to keep up. Our Rambler® 20 oz. is made from durable stainless steel with double-wall vacuum insulation to protect your hot or cold beverage at all costs. Like the entire Rambler Family, [the 20 oz. Tumbler](https://el2.fourhourmail.com/c/n4u05gdnnavh2go89hq/25h2hoho56rvvdb3/aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cueWV0aS5jb20vZW5fVVMvZHJpbmt3YXJlL3JhbWJsZXItMjAtb3otdHVtYmxlci8yMTA3MTUwMDMwOS5odG1sI3N0YXJ0PTE=) and its lid are dishwasher safe for easy cleaning…. Available in Stainless, Duracoat™ colors and Seasonal finishes. Layered with an advanced, oleophobic coating (which is science for: it’s fingerprint-proof), tested to the highest level of UV resistance, and equally as dishwasher safe, durable, and insulated as its predecessors.”
